name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Kbd: a key cap drawn in ink. A 2px frame with a heavier 3px bottom edge, like a pressed key; paper inside; lettering inside, uppercase. KbdGroup spaces a chord (Ctrl K). No tone (under 24px). Keys are not interactive: no hover, press or focus state. Works inline in a sentence, in a tooltip and on an ink flat.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/kbd". It wraps your own components/ui/kbd, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A key cap in ink, with a heavier bottom edge like a pressed key.
